assign.outcome:
**One page now says what the last three days produced, and the list of what is left is checked rather than copied.** [The last three days](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/review-3-days/) reads the three days newest-first as three cards side by side — one headline sentence each, six short lines with links, and what that day left behind — then five things waiting on you, then a three-sentence verdict on the dashboard itself. 2,206px at 1280 with zero console errors, and the three day headlines sit above the fold.

![the page at 1280](/framework/ai/2026-09-22/review-3-days/shots/page-1280-full.png)

**Every open item was verified against the repo, not carried forward.** Seven waiting items became six: minion permissions are solved (`acceptEdits` plus an explicit tool list both writes and runs), and the V3 head row is fixed — 255px at 400px wide became **133px**, measured today on a private server, which nobody had been able to prove because the session that shipped it could not run a command. The restart, the settings block, the shelf, six of seven skill changes and the three server-side fixes are all still true, each with the check that proved it. The same corrections went into [handover.md](/framework/ai/handover.md)'s waiting list and [Start here](/framework/ai/2026-09-20/start-here/), whose "still broken" section named two things that had since been fixed.

**Six task pages were walls of text; all six now read as one screen.** Measured all 44 pages from the three days first: the tall ones split cleanly into pages that are tall because they SHOW something (kept) and pages that are tall because nobody folded anything (fixed). Nothing was deleted — the trailing sections moved behind a fold, with a dated comment in each file saying why. [mistake-audit](/framework/ai/2026-09-19/mistake-audit/) 3,780→2,366px · [skills-shrink](/framework/ai/2026-09-19/skills-shrink/) 3,120→2,027 · [worktree-study](/framework/ai/2026-09-19/worktree-study/) 3,186→2,223 · [incident-site-down](/framework/ai/2026-09-19/incident-site-down/) 3,210→2,409 · [padding-audit](/framework/ai/2026-09-19/padding-audit/) 3,707→2,983 · [card-adopt](/framework/ai/2026-09-19/card-adopt/) 5,100→4,341. Total down 26%, all eight touched pages re-crawled with zero console errors, and the new page proven reachable by clicking from the day board.

**The dashboard proposal, for the mastermind, not built here:** the front door is a stream of 458 cards, 227 of them narration, while what each task actually produced lives in that task's own log with nothing joining the two. A fourth view, Days, reading only each task's finishing line would make the default answer to "what happened" a dozen finished sentences instead of four hundred moments.

**Left, with why.** The page is 2,206px — about 2.75 screens, not the two the brief asked for; the four deliverables would not compress further without dropping one, so the cut went into the day cards and the fold instead. [day-audit](/framework/ai/2026-09-19/day-audit/) is the tallest page of the three days at 7,005px and was left alone on purpose: it already carries 65 folds and it is a data page, not a wall of text. Landing lines that are essays could not be fixed — `task.jsonl` is append-only.
